sources.title: User's Wtop requirements and implementation authorization
sources.scope: Product intent, native TUI preference, historical scope and permission to implement; not execution evidence.

sources.title: Inherited NTop source baseline
sources.scope: Source and inherited GPL notice; no current Wtop platform qualification.

sources.title: Open Knowledge Format 0.2
sources.scope: Full upstream structural specification read; upstream does not define Wtop requirements, schemas or work units.

sources.title: AIDE engineering OKF profile
sources.scope: Proposed imported design, not an adopted execution protocol. Independently version local extensions; provenance is not authority.

sources.title: DiskEd OKF authoring profile and schemas
sources.scope: Read profile, frontmatter, requirement, acceptance and work-unit schemas. Patterns inform original Wtop definitions; DiskEd's separate-grant workflow is not copied.

sources.title: SysPane CPU state and Windows acquisition
sources.scope: Selected processor_state, processor_windows and handoff sources read. One-group Windows10 evidence is repository-reported, not rerun here; code is modern C++.

sources.title: SysPane measurement callback ownership
sources.scope: Read serialized owner and lifetime handoff. A lock cannot interrupt a blocked native call; no code redistribution license inferred.

sources.title: ScreenSave portable semantics and evidence classes
sources.scope: Read contract, session/clock/base headers and support matrix. Current unsigned-int width assertion is not a 16-bit ABI; broad historical execution remains unqualified.

sources.title: Microsoft PE format
sources.scope: Machine/subsystem fields and ABI boundaries; a common extension does not establish compatibility.

sources.title: Microsoft Windows PE introduction
sources.scope: Subset runtime and no MSI. Native matching-architecture baseline; WinPE-x64-Support is an optional Arm64 exception recorded separately.

sources.title: Microsoft Windows Installer platform restrictions
sources.scope: Windows RT packages require Microsoft signature; ordinary third-party desktop distribution is not a supported stock-RT path.

sources.title: Open Watcom target and linker documentation
sources.scope: Advertises DOS, Windows1 through3.x, Win9x/NT and OS2 targets; toolchain target listing is not Wtop execution proof.

sources.title: Microsoft process security and access rights
sources.scope: Least-access queries, protected process restrictions and API-version differences.

sources.title: Microsoft NtQuerySystemInformation
sources.scope: Native structures may change; isolate layouts, validate buffers and dynamically resolve optional APIs.

sources.title: Microsoft console creation and subsystem behavior
sources.scope: Console association and GUI process allocation do not force separate applications; shell/redirect behavior needs tests.

sources.title: Microsoft Windows CE platform SDKs
sources.scope: OEM platform SDK and image components qualify a CE target; CPU, instruction set and image are explicit.

sources.title: ReactOS project compatibility declaration
sources.scope: Server2003 compatibility focus and alpha status; Wtop still needs tests on a pinned build.

sources.title: Microsoft WinGet requirements
sources.scope: WinGet requires Windows10 1809 or later; not a historic OS installation mechanism.

sources.title: Microsoft historical Installer redistributables
sources.scope: MSI versions have explicit Win9x/NT4 service-pack requirements; no universal historical MSI.

sources.title: Microsoft known folder identifiers
sources.scope: Installed modern Windows path roles; older profiles use a version-qualified adapter.

sources.title: Microsoft DOS1.25 EXE loader and interrupt dispatcher
sources.scope: Loader header, COM/EXE selection and relocation inspected. Adjacent MSDOS.ASM dispatcher ends at2Eh; DOS2 handle APIs absent. This proves source behavior for1.25, not every1.0OEM.

sources.title: Microsoft WinPE optional components
sources.scope: WinPE-x64-Support provides x64 emulation on Arm64; optional components must match ADK build and image architecture. No Wtop runtime qualification inferred.

sources.title: Microsoft Research Experiment19 and Windows Phone kernels
sources.scope: Microsoft identifies Windows Phone7 as CE and Windows Phone8 as NT. This does not qualify Wtop desktop APIs or unrestricted deployment on phones.

sources.title: htop default action bindings and manual
sources.scope: Reference interaction semantics and documented F1-F10/screen behavior; no htop implementation code imported.

sources.title: htop default terminal color roles
sources.scope: Reference foreground/background roles; terminal palette RGB and Windows telemetry semantics remain independent.
